{{Quote|What was that?”<br>”I saw nothing-which, given my monocular vision, is unsurprising.”<br>”It was there. Over there by that fuel port.”<br>”Are you sure-”<br>”Yes, I'm sure. I'm-there! ''Right there''!|Den Dhur and I-5YQ about spotting the Inquisitor|<ref name="Last Jedi" />}}
While waiting for [[Jax Pavan]] to return from infiltrating the [[ISB Central Office/Legends|ISB Central Offices]] to try and find [[Thi Xon Yimmon]], [[Den Dhur]] and [[I-5YQ]] waited aboard their ship [[Laranth]], registered officially as Corsair. While waiting they spotted a cloaked figure, an '''Inquisitor''', around their ship. The [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] made two circuits around the ship before Den decided to try and chase him away with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. I-Five dissuaded him and went out instead, making an act about having seen thieves. He swiveled his head to try and spot the Inquisitor and shot a laser at him. There was some noise and movement and then the Inquisitor vanished. Den and I-Five thought they saw the Inquisitor return shortly after only for it to be Jax in his Inquisitor robe. When Den asked Jax why he was skulking outside, Jax explained that he hadn’t and only just got back. That spurred unease in Den about if [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] knew Jax was still alive, knew their ship and that he knew Jax had gone to the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] or whether the Inquisitor was on patrol looking for [[The Force/Legends|Force]] users and was drawn by the residual of Pavan’s Force signature. Dhur also worried about Vader taking interest in a report from the Inquisitor about being shot at, as that would bring quick attention to them. So as a result Jax, Den and Five decided to flee [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] before any swift attention could be drawn.<ref name="Last Jedi" />
